preconditions.description: Input is an odd integer x in the range [3, 999999].

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in [f'{a} + {b}', f'{a} ^ {b}'] for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:]) and all(' ' in line for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each operation line after the first is either a sum or XOR operation with two numbers already on the blackboard, separated by whitespace.
The number of operations q is at most 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(num) <= 5e18 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:] for num in line.split() if num.isdigit())
postconditions.description: All numbers written on the blackboard are in the range [0, 5e18].
The number 1 is present in the sequence of operations (either as an operand or result).
